mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_board WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_no, board_id
mapper.sql: p.post_id, p.board_id, b.board_nm, b.board_cd, b.board_type, p.title, p.content, p.author_id, CASE WHEN p.anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN '익명' ELSE u.name END AS author_name, CASE WHEN p.anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN '' ELSE COALESCE(d.dept_nm,'') END AS author_dept, p.pinned_yn, p.anonymous_yn, p.view_cnt, p.answered_yn, p.attach_group_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_board_post (board_id, title, content, author_id, pinned_yn, anonymous_yn, attach_group_id, created_by) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, COALESCE(#{pinnedYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{anonymousYn},'N'), #{attachGroupId}, #{authorId})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_board_post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, pinned_yn = COALESCE(#{pinnedYn}, pinned_yn), anonymous_yn = COALESCE(#{anonymousYn}, anonymous_yn), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{authorId} WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE gw_board_post SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE gw_board_post SET view_cnt = view_cnt + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE gw_board_post SET answered_yn = 'Y' WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_board_post p JOIN gw_board b ON b.board_id = p.board_id LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gw_board_post p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.board_id = #{boardId}
AND (LOWER(p.title) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR LOWER(p.content) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_board_comment (post_id, parent_cmt_id, author_id, content, anonymous_yn) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentCmtId}, #{authorId}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{anonymousYn}, 'N'))
mapper.select: SELECT c.cmt_id, c.post_id, c.parent_cmt_id, c.author_id, CASE WHEN c.anonymous_yn = 'Y' THEN '익명' ELSE u.name END AS author_name, c.content, c.anonymous_yn, c.created_at FROM gw_board_comment c LEFT JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = c.author_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at
